text:
elaine: Quick heads-up: planning a cross-service deploy tonight 21:45-22:10 UTC. Order: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Calling out router header compatibility risk.

richard: API: sha-api-4c3 ready. No DB work. Canary low-impact.

kai: Runtime: promoting 3.3.0-quant (sha-rt-330q). It sends X-Runtime-Mode: quant. Older routers may 400 if header not whitelisted. Need router config reload or we run runtime in compat mode.

elaine: Proposed canary: eu-only 1% for 10m, then 10% for 5m. deploybot will run prewarm probe after api canary to warm KV cache.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave 21:50 UTC. Sequence: api=sha-api-4c3,runtime=sha-rt-330q,console=sha-ui-30,router=sha-router-14. Canary policy as requested. Auto-rollback enabled.

richard: Fallback: runtime-compat tag sha-rt-329x is ready. If router whitelist not applied within 7m after runtime canary, we pin to 3.2.x and hold router.

kai: Note: router reload can be staggered; it takes ~40s per instance. Ops-watch will watch logs for 400/401 spikes.

ops-watch: Staging smoke OK: 10/10 checks. p99 api 100ms, p99 runtime 160ms. Alerts configured.

elaine: Rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 3m or p99>2s for 3m or healthcheck failures >2/min for 5m. If urgent, reply exactly "rollback" and deploybot will run rollback.

richard: I'll be monitoring traces. Kai you watch runtime & router logs.

kai: On it, will tail router-14 and runtime metrics.

elaine: Please ack if you can monitor at 21:45 UTC. If no ack by 21:30 we postpone.

richard: Ack.

kai: Ack.

deploybot: deploybot: ready to start on approval. Events to #release-notifications and webhooks to SRE.
